body.name: Complete TID-SCG trace for the outside-class witness
body.construction: For \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\), the complete trace is \(s_0\to s_1\to s_2\to s_3\to s_4\): \(s_0\) initializes the query frontier \(\{X_{-1},Y_0\}\); \(s_1\) closes it in the maximal legal refinement to \(\{X_{-1},X_0,Y_0\}\) and records the nonempty admissible edge-offset set \(\Delta_{12}\subseteq\{0,1\}\); \(s_2\) records that every admissible branch has singleton intrinsic districts because \(H_{\mathrm{out}}\) has no bidirected edge, with the order constraint \(X_0\prec Y_0\) when \(0\in\Delta_{12}\); \(s_3\) fixes the two treatment-coordinate roles and compiles the branch-independent kernels \(q_Y(1\mid0,a)=P(Y_0=1\mid X_{-1}=0,X_0=a)\) and \(q_0(a)=P(X_0=a)\); \(s_4\) sums the natural instantaneous treatment role and returns \(\operatorname{SUCCESS}(F_{\mathrm{out}})\), where \(F_{\mathrm{out}}(P)=\sum_{a\in\mathcal A_1}q_Y(1\mid0,a)q_0(a)\). Positivity makes every conditional cylinder well defined, and the recorded offset set covers lag zero, lag one, and their simultaneous presence without refinement enumeration.
